invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new HashMap instance, so 'result' cannot be null.
The map is instantiated as a HashMap and always returned as such.
The method puts at most one entry in the map or none at all, so the size can only be 0 or 1.
The only possible key is PLAN_STRATEGY_SORT_COLUMNS.key(), which cannot be null.
All keys put into the map are strings, as defined by the map type and usage.
